description: ExtendFootprintTTL (CAP-0046-12) with extendTo = 0 and an empty footprint, applied with txSUCCESS. stellar-core rejects only an extendTo above the network's maximum entry TTL, so 0 is valid. java-stellar-sdk refused this transaction until lightsail-network/java-stellar-sdk#811; kmp-stellar-sdk 1.18.0 refuses it (Soneso/kmp-stellar-sdk#176). Submitted by a third party; reported in lightsail-network/java-stellar-sdk#810.

core_version_and_commit.basis: UNVERIFIED: a testnet ledger at protocol 27 from the public data lake; the data-lake emitter does not publish its core build

generator_version: none (historical capture from the public Galexie data lake)

expected_state_changes_or_participants.indexer_must: accept extendTo = 0 and an empty footprint; the operation succeeds and changes no entry
expected_state_changes_or_participants.note: the operation meta has no changes

validation_evidence.check: rs-stellar-xdr strict decode and byte-exact re-encode
ledger header hash recomputed from header bytes and matched to the recorded ledger hash
validation_evidence.method: ledgerwitness verify; ledger hash independently read from Horizon testnet /ledgers/3619212

validation_evidence.check: header signed by a pinned testnet validator
every envelope hashes under the declared passphrase to a processed result

validation_evidence.method: not applicable to network captures: core goldens are produced by core's own test suite under its test passphrase; see docs/spec/normalization.md

validation_evidence.check: no second copy of the ledger
validation_evidence.method: the ledger is older than RPC's retention window, so the data-lake copy is the only artifact

validation_evidence.check: transaction successful, source account and extend_to as Horizon reports them; ledger transaction count
validation_evidence.method: GET horizon-testnet /transactions/{hash} (successful, source_account), /transactions/{hash}/operations (type extend_footprint_ttl, extend_to 0) and /ledgers/3619212 (4 successful plus 2 failed)

license_or_provenance_notes: Public testnet ledger data from the public Galexie data lake (AWS Open Data, aws-public-blockchain). The focus transaction was submitted by a third party.
